subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in TUI run-completion notifier, and which notification modes and config shape should be supported first?
rationale: The request adds user-visible TUI behavior plus config/platform notification policy; automation can confirm the gap but cannot choose the product boundary, defaults, or macOS-vs-terminal behavior safely.

options.title: Design a default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify a small contract, likely starting with terminal bell or a safe platform-notification adapter plus config/docs/tests.

options.title: Keep TUI visual-only
options.body: Decline the core feature and document external workarounds such as shell wrappers, node notifications, or OS terminal alerts instead of adding config surface.

options.title: Defer to broader alerting work
options.body: Wait for the gateway watchdog or urgent-alert design to settle, then decide whether TUI completion notifications should be a separate local-only feature.

recommendation.title: Design a default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify a small contract, likely starting with terminal bell or a safe platform-notification adapter plus config/docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history signal for adjacent TUI status/watchdog review and likely product-boundary ownership.
